d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

As a key member of the project team, you will be responsible for delivering safe, sustainable and high-quality engineering solutions across the project lifecycle. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, manage client relationships, and ensure successful project delivery by balancing safety, quality, schedule and cost objectives. Your expertise will help drive engineering excellence, support operational readiness, and create long-term value for our clients.
q: You are a proactive and results-driven leader with the ability to manage complex projects and diverse teams.

You are an experienced engineering leader with a track record of successfully delivering projects within the Oil & Gas, refining or petrochemical industries. You bring strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness and leadership capability, combined with the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders.
Lead multidisciplinary teams in complex project environments.
Balance safety, quality, cost and schedule priorities.
Communicate effectively across diverse cultures and stakeholder groups.
Manage multiple priorities and deliver results under demanding timelines.
Coach and mentor teams while fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture.
Maintain strong governance, procedural compliance and auditability throughout project delivery.
Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering from an accredited university.
Minimum 15 years of total experience post graduate studies.
Minimum 10 years of experience in the oil & gas, refinery, or petrochemical industry.
Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role.
Experience working in a PMC (Project Management Consultancy) environment.
Demonstrated experience delivering projects within the Middle East is preferred; Kuwait experience will be an advantage.
Prior project involvement covering Onshore Effluent Water Treatment and Injection Facilities will be an advantage.
Strong technical, practical and leadership experience within the relevant discipline.
Proven experience leading discipline engineering and design teams.
Strong understanding of project procedures, governance requirements and audit trail management.
Proficiency in standard business software applications; experience with engineering software will be an advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively across multicultural environments.
Strong planning, organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Willingness and ability to engage directly with clients and represent Worley professionally.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and mentor others.

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
r: Manage, coordinate and supervise assigned projects, ensuring delivery in line with approved scope, budget, schedule and quality objectives.
Oversee engineering, procurement and construction management activities delivered by contractors and project stakeholders.
Support Oil & Gas production activities, including start-up, commissioning and initial operations assistance, as required by the client.
Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities for FEED studies, cost estimate development, ITB preparation, tender package development and project execution.
Serve as the primary technical interface with the client, ensuring alignment with project objectives and expectations.
Ensure all project activities comply with the approved Basis of Design, contractual requirements, applicable regulations and industry codes.
Drive Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance
Champion a strong HSE culture across the project team.
Ensure HSE requirements are fully integrated into engineering, design and procurement activities.
Develop and maintain effective, long-term relationships with clients.
Proactively manage and resolve scope, schedule and performance issues.
Clearly identify, communicate and deliver client requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage assigned project budgets within Worley's scope of work.
Ensure compliance with project management plans, contractual obligations and company procedures.
Apply effective change management and change control processes.
Support claims prevention, mitigation and management where required.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of project schedules.
Monitor project progress and ensure activities are executed in accordance with approved plans.
Track project costs, forecast outcomes, identify trends and implement corrective actions to prevent cost overruns.
Promote Value Improving Practices (VIPs) to maximise project efficiency and capital effectiveness.
Support compliance with Worley policies, procedures and quality standards.
Maintain a strong working knowledge of Worley engineering, procurement and project delivery systems.
Establish clear objectives for engineering teams, including productivity, budget and quality targets.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, industry standards and engineering codes.
Effectively manage interfaces between disciplines and stakeholders.
Foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment focused on delivering project milestones and objectives.
Coach, mentor and support team members in achieving their full potential.
Resolve issues, remove barriers and drive accountability across the project team.
Provide accurate, timely and effective reporting to project leadership and clients.
Maintain clear communication with project teams, contractors and third parties.
Deliver professional presentations and communicate complex information effectively.
Monitor project risks and opportunities and drive actions to achieve timely closure.
Monitor procurement activities to ensure materials and equipment meet specifications, are delivered on schedule and remain within budget.
Support effective subcontract and vendor management throughout project execution.

The role holds full responsibility for the store’s results, operations, and budget.
Lead, coach, and develop Store Managers and team leaders to ensure their teams consistently deliver the Louis Vuitton promise.
Identify, recruit, and develop talents while securing succession plans.
Translate strategic and business objectives into clear individual and team goals.
Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performance work environment that encourages ownership and innovation.
Drive the overall business performance of the store through a strong understanding of the market, clients, and commercial levers.
Build a loyal client base and ensure a strong client-centric mindset across the store.
Act as the voice of the store by providing insights, recommendations, and feedback based on local market knowledge.
Proven experience in luxury retail management, with strong people leadership exposure.
Demonstrated ability to drive commercial performance and develop high-performing teams.
Strong business acumen with a client-centric mindset.
Excellent leadership, communication, and influencing skills.
Comfortable operating with full accountability for business results and operations.
Strong understanding of local market dynamics.
